scope: Read-only source impact review. No tests, browser, build, database requests, checkpoint access or product edits.

delta.summary: Optional post-save Source filing panel, associations store and dependency, keepSource expectedActor forwarding, informational notice icon/role, package and global CSS drift.

d22_preservation.finding: use-page-recognition.ts and supabase/queries.ts unchanged by incoming range; selected-organization lookup filters, lookup serial invalidation, late response/broadcast rejection remain intact.
api/client.ts, sources/save-capture.ts and capture-ladder/queue.ts unchanged; the existing pinned actor and revision/terminal queue mechanisms were not replaced.

FileSourcePanel is nested under saved && savedSource. Existing saved predicate requires matching active organization, current capture identity and unedited capture. Incoming filingFor state alone cannot render the old workspace claim after a switch.

setFilingFor runs after successful landing and the new panel receives savedSource.organizationId. keepSource forwards supplied expectedActor through existing post/client plumbing. Existing save path does not wait for filing.

new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.finding: FileSourcePanel supplies expectedActor only when userId is non-null; it otherwise calls keepSource with undefined. The new unit tests mock keepSource, so they do not prove refusal before network across authentication/workspace changes.
new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.required_check: Add/execute real-client keepSource boundary cases: supplied actor workspace switch before headers emits zero requests; null session never results in a write under a later identity; dispatched request stays bound to its original actor.

new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.finding: useMyLibraries filters created_by and deleted_at, but not selected organization; remembered Library keys are per user, and libraryId can remain selected when absent from returned options. This is a filing selection concern requiring contract/schema validation, not proof of an unauthorized DB write.
new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.required_check: Verify whether Libraries are intentionally selectable across accessible organizations and whether a remembered unavailable Library is visibly represented before filing. Do not claim current mocked library tests prove RLS or workspace isolation.

new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.finding: Filing uses the same LandingOutcome/refusal parser as capture saving. Local transport-refusal wording describes a page kept on this device, although this filing action has no queue persistence.
new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.required_check: Exercise filing refusal with the real transport/parser and check that the message accurately describes the already-landed Source and unsaved filing selection. No runtime defect claim made here.

new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.finding: save-source-logic parity test skips when the frontend file is absent.
new_filing_risks_not_proven_d22_regressi.required_check: Resolve MATRX_FRONTEND_DIR to the actual sibling checkout before running parity; explicitly record a skip if unavailable, never claim cross-client parity from a skipped test.

readonly_runner_impact.finding: No direct selector, query shape or Source-link route change in incoming range. Runner never creates a local savedSource and therefore never mounts or exercises the new filing panel. Shared dependency/CSS changes can still alter real layout and must be tested in the fresh artifact.
readonly_runner_impact.coverage_limits: Runner is prepared, not runtime-verified. Does not prove filing, immediate intermediate-state claim clearing, service-failure/recovery, or native late Save.
readonly_runner_impact.checkpoint: Reserved SourceSave checkpoint remains forbidden to read/write/reset/delete/reinitialize/retry in the next runner. Do not switch to default recovery.

Guarded single-worker Vitest against current tree.
Guarded single-worker Vitest. Preserve honest distinction between mocked panel tests and real transport/UI coverage.

Build current integrated development tree after dependency reconciliation; issue a new immutable development receipt and independent receipt review. Earlier .82 artifact is stale even though package version is unchanged. Do not overwrite historical receipt or relabel old hash.

After independent runner review and root sole-heavy admission, run SOURCE_READONLY_SCOPE=1 and the new source-recognition-readonly runner with fresh SOURCE_DEV_BUILD_RECEIPT. Report each bounded result separately. Positive fixture absence remains unverified.

not_authorized_as_substitute.reason: Incoming file-source e2e signs in through password API, injects extension storage, creates a project, writes filing/Source state and soft-deletes during cleanup. saved-captures e2e also has write/cleanup behavior. Neither is the approved real-login, checkpoint-independent read-only D22 run. Do not add either to the current resource allowance or launch for this retest.

closure: D22 remains open pending current-build authenticated multi-workspace native evidence. Existing engineering fixes need regression checks, not a speculative rewrite. This report does not close D22 or validate optional filing.
